title: Gadget Zone technical SEO fixes with zero visual/layout changes

requirements.summary: Update document title and meta description in frontend/index.html to provided values with no UI impact.
acceptanceCriteria: frontend/index.html <title> is exactly "Gadget Zone | Mobile Store in Thiruvanmiyur Chennai"

frontend/index.html contains a single <meta name="description"> with content exactly "Gadget Zone is a trusted mobile store in Thiruvanmiyur, Chennai for smartphones, accessories, repairs, EMI options & CCTV solutions."
No visible layout or styling changes occur (meta-only changes)

file_operations.description: Replace the existing <title> and the single <meta name="description"> to exactly match the provided Meta Title and Meta Description; ensure only one description meta remains and do not change any other head/body markup to avoid any visible/layout changes.

requirements.summary: Ensure exactly one H1 ('Gadget Zone') and render the specified main section headings as H2 without changing visual styling or section order.

Each listed main section title is rendered as an

No additional <h1> elements exist anywhere on the page

file_operations.description: Audit all section title elements and adjust semantic tags only: keep the existing hero heading as the sole <h1> with text exactly "Gadget Zone"; change the main section headings to <h2> for: "Brands We Deal With", "Products & Services", "Why Choose Us", "HOT PICK", and "Store Gallery"; preserve existing className/style props to prevent any visible typography/spacing changes and keep section order unchanged.

requirements.summary: Add hash-based in-page anchor navigation for service cards, the HOT PICK control, and footer links while preserving current look and behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Each service description section has a stable id attribute (e.g., derived from the service name) and clicking its corresponding card updates the URL hash and scrolls to that section
The floating HOT PICK control includes a real anchor target (href to the HOT PICK section id) and still scrolls to the HOT PICK section when activated
Footer contains visible links that navigate via hash anchors to Products, Services, and Contact sections (no route changes)
All anchor additions preserve existing styles and do not reflow or reorder content

file_operations.description: Introduce stable id attributes for the relevant in-page sections (service description sections, HOT PICK section, Products/Services section(s), and Contact section) and wire hash navigation: update service card interactions to include real <a href="#..."> navigation (or equivalent) that updates window.location.hash while keeping existing smooth-scroll and analytics behavior; ensure the target sections scroll into view and content order/layout remain unchanged.

Update the floating HOT PICK control to be a real anchor (href pointing to the HOT PICK section id, e.g. "#hot-pick-section") while preserving the exact visual styling/className and existing click behavior (smooth scroll/analytics handled by the parent).

requirements.summary: Add LocalBusiness JSON-LD structured data in the document head without affecting UI.
acceptanceCriteria: A single JSON-LD <script type="application/ld+json"> is present in the document head
Schema type is LocalBusiness (or a more specific subtype if already used) and includes name "Gadget Zone"
Schema includes address with locality "Chennai" and region "Tamil Nadu" and references Thiruvanmiyur
Schema includes the phone number and a WhatsApp contact URL/identifier based on existing site values (+919840077591 and 919840077591 as used in the UI)
Schema includes business hours matching the UI (10 AM – 9 PM)
Schema includes a list of services offered aligned with the existing Products/Services content
No visible UI changes occur

file_operations.description: Add exactly one <script type="application/ld+json"> in the <head> defining LocalBusiness structured data for Gadget Zone, including: name, address (Thiruvanmiyur, Chennai, Tamil Nadu), phone (+919840077591), WhatsApp (https://wa.me/919840077591), business hours (10 AM–9 PM), and a servicesOffered list aligned to the existing Products/Services items; ensure this is head-only and does not change any visible UI.

requirements.summary: Add a single canonical link tag in the document head matching the sitemap homepage URL (non-www).
acceptanceCriteria: frontend/index.html contains exactly one <link rel="canonical">
Canonical href equals "https://gadgetzone-nz9.caffeine.xyz/" (non-www) as per frontend/public/sitemap.xml
No visible UI changes occur

file_operations.description: Insert (or update) exactly one <link rel="canonical"> in the <head> with href set to "https://gadgetzone-nz9.caffeine.xyz/" (matching frontend/public/sitemap.xml); ensure no other canonical tags exist and there are no UI/layout changes.

requirements.summary: Add Open Graph tags (og:title, og:description, og:image) in frontend/index.html using provided title/description and an existing image asset.
acceptanceCriteria: frontend/index.html includes og:title matching "Gadget Zone | Mobile Store in Thiruvanmiyur Chennai"
frontend/index.html includes og:description matching the provided meta description exactly

frontend/index.html includes og:image referencing an existing image already in the project (no new image generation) and uses an absolute URL when possible (e.g., canonical base + existing asset path)
No visible UI changes occur

file_operations.description: Add Open Graph meta tags in the <head>: og:title (provided title), og:description (provided meta description), and og:image referencing an existing asset with an absolute URL (e.g., "https://gadgetzone-nz9.caffeine.xyz/assets/generated/gadget-zone-logo.dim_512x512.png"); do not create/modify images and ensure no visible UI/layout changes.
